lines.zh: 我踱着步，等下一个弟子
lines.en: I pace, waiting for the next student.
Hands behind my back, I circle the pillars.

lines.zh: 我的脚步声在这厅里很响
lines.en: My steps ring through this hall.
I walk to the window and check the sky.
I drift to the centre of the yard.

lines.zh: 我绕着你转，是在看你站姿
lines.en: I circle you to check your stance.
I stroll over to the punching bag.

lines.zh: 我的拖鞋在地上蹭出声
lines.en: My sandals scrape the floor.

lines.zh: 我走到哪儿，哪儿就安静
lines.en: Wherever I walk, the room quiets.

lines.zh: 我一步一晃，像在打拍子
lines.en: I sway with each step, keeping time.

lines.zh: 我从这头走到那头，再回来
lines.en: I walk the length of the hall and back.
I pause on the steps and look out.

lines.zh: 我绕着训练场走完一圈
lines.en: I complete one lap of the training ground.
I shift my spot and keep watching.
I stand, beard stirring in the wind.

lines.zh: 我不说话，是在等你先开口
lines.en: I stay silent so you speak first.
This hall is too quiet.
Eyes shut, my ki is circulating.
I lift a hand and smooth my beard.
I look at my own fist.

lines.zh: 我哼了一声，不知是赞是贬
lines.en: I grunt, and it could mean anything.
I wait; I am in no hurry.
I sit cross-legged, then rise again.

lines.zh: 我的气把灰尘推向四周
lines.en: My ki pushes the dust outward.

lines.zh: 我盯着墙上的一道裂痕
lines.en: I stare at a crack in the wall.
I cough to clear my throat.
I count your breaths silently.
I shake my head and smile.
You are here. Stand straight.

lines.zh: 我看得出你的气还不稳
lines.en: I can see your ki is unsteady.
You are gripping your fists too hard.
I am waiting for you to ask.

lines.zh: 你这身打扮是来练拳的
lines.en: You dressed for training, I see.
I look you over once.
There is a little promise in you.
Let me see your eyes.
Your ki sinks; remember that.
I nod, now you may ask.
Standing that far, I cannot hear you.

lines.zh: 我给你一句话，你记十年
lines.en: I will give you one line worth ten years.

lines.zh: 我指了指场地，示意你过去
lines.en: I point at the yard and gesture you over.
You stand straighter than last time.
Even at my age I take hits.
I step back and catch my breath.
Your punch has improved.
It hurts, but I stand.
I wipe the corner of my mouth.
I smile; I am not angry.
I will remember that one.
I raise a hand to stop you.
Again, I am still standing.
I do not eat, I teach.
Take that plate away.
Feed yourself first.

lines.zh: 我这把年纪，早就吃够了
lines.en: At my age I have eaten enough.
If you are hungry, the kitchen is that way.

lines.zh: 你把那盘东西举这么高
lines.en: Why hold that plate up so high?
I do not accept such a gift.

lines.zh: 比起食物，我更想看你的拳
lines.en: I would rather see your fist.
Put it down and we will talk.
Food is too small a tuition.
You bumped me. Steady.
This old frame is still sturdy.
Do not crowd, there is room.

lines.zh: 你退后一点，我看不见你
lines.en: Step back, I cannot see you whole.
I steady you with one hand.
You are on my robe.

lines.zh: 力道太散，撞人都撞不实
lines.en: Scattered force; even that bump was weak.
I take a step back and give you the spot.
You cannot even hold your ground.
That bump, I let you have it.
At my age, teaching is all I want.
None of that. Go train.
I had my days too.
So many students here, that is enough.

lines.zh: 我一个人站在这，就很好
lines.en: Standing here alone suits me.
My mind is on the next lesson.
I do not discuss such things.
Ask someone else.
I smile and say nothing.
My beard is white, and you bring this up.
I pick it up and hand it back.
Nothing stays on the floor.
That is my tea bowl.
You dropped this.
I do not know this thing.
I weigh it in my palm.
A student dropped it, so I keep it safe.
Do not leave it about, someone will trip.

lines.zh: 我盯住你，是因为你走神了
lines.en: I fix on you because you lost focus.
That punch was late.
I am testing your reflexes.
Step into the circle.
Do not dodge, take it head on.
I am using one tenth of my strength.
I have your shoulder locked in my sight.
If you cannot block it, learn from it.
I strike at three.
I raise my hand slowly so you see it.
Your weight has shifted left.
I am waiting for your punch.
I will not rush; you move first.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛一直没离开你的肩
lines.en: My eyes have not left your shoulder.
Hesitate and you get hit.
I am teaching you distance.
Relax your shoulders; only then will your punch land.
I circle, forcing you to turn.
Remember this lesson.
I only tap you.
That was a reminder.
Seven steps back; not bad.

lines.zh: 我收着力，不然你站不住
lines.en: I held back, or you would not stand.
Your guard broke.
Does it hurt? Remember that spot.
Again, and block properly.
I struck your opening.
Your hands are too low.
That is enough for today.
I have been here all along.
This hall is my classroom.
You found this place, so you mean it.
I stand here and students come.
The door opens, and I look up.
I chose this building.

lines.zh: 我不去别处，我就在这一间
lines.en: I go nowhere else; this room is mine.

lines.zh: 灰尘落下来，我又扫了一遍
lines.en: Dust settles, and I sweep it again.
You came at the right time.
Fire catches the hem of my robe.
I slip off the steps.
Water fills my nose.

lines.zh: 气浪把我推得撞在柱子上
lines.en: The blast throws me into a pillar.

lines.zh: 一根箭钉在我身旁的柱上
lines.en: An arrow sticks in the pillar beside me.

lines.zh: 魔法缠住我的气，很难受
lines.en: Magic knots my ki, and it stings.
I have gone too long without tea.

lines.zh: 雷落在这厅顶上，瓦都响了
lines.en: Lightning hits the roof and the tiles ring.
The floor vanished beneath me.
